notes.title: Summoning And Divination Is Here!🧙
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello fellow Mystical Brewers! ⚗️🧪🔮[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Summoning And Divination is bringing new life to wisps!
These wisps will help you gather, refine and read books.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Divination 🌀[/b][/p][p]Siphon mana through mana pools. These are used to create mana containers that are used in summoning[/p][p][/p][p][b]Summoning 🧙‍♂️[/b][/p][p]The heart of this update! Summon wisps to help you out![/p][p]This is the automation part, let the wisps do all manual labor, but you need to siphon the mana for them of course 🌀[/p][p][/p][p]And there are more achievements and more QOL improvements through out the game[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][p]Thank you all for reporting in the bugs! ❤️[/p][p]🔮 Fixed a lot of spelling errors[/p][p]🔮 Fixed so the refine button does not release when done[/p][p]🔮 Fixed instant refinement completion when dragging the item out of bounds[/p][p]🔮 Money bug when buying items, would go to negative money instead[/p][p]🔮 Many more changes[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for checking this game out ❤️
Stay tuned for more and would love your feedback on this update[/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/znKeXgdUFQ"]https://discord.com/invite/znKeXgdUFQ[/url][/p]
